Process.heading: Simple. Guided. Personal.
Process.step1Body: Choose your piece (suit, blazer, trousers or shirt), your style, and your colour and fit preferences.
Process.step2Body: A private video call to refine your style, confirm your choices, and take your measurements together, step by step.
Process.step3Body: Your piece is crafted from your validated brief by experienced artisans.
Process.step4Body: Your suit is inspected before shipping. Luc remains available after delivery to support you.

LucSection.heading: An appointment with Luc.
LucSection.paragraph1: Every suit starts with a private call. Luc guides you through the choice of style, cut and details, then takes your measurements with you live, even remotely.
LucSection.paragraph2: No shop, no waiting line. Just you, Luc, and the suit you need.
LucSection.paragraph3: A former high-level athlete and ESCP graduate, Luc lived and worked in six countries before learning cutting and tailoring, in France and then in Shanghai. SLY Atelier was born from that same standard: the craftsmanship of a great atelier, without the address that makes it out of reach.
LucSection.requirementsEyebrow: What you'll need for the appointment
LucSection.req1Desc: To hold the tape and note down the measurements while you stand straight and natural.
LucSection.req2Desc: A soft, tailor's tape measure. Available at a pharmacy or haberdashery for under €2.
LucSection.req3Desc: The appointment lasts 45 minutes on average. Leave yourself a little margin so you're not rushed.
LucSection.req4Desc: Stable connection, good light. A room without background noise so we can communicate clearly.

Promise.heading: Ordering made-to-measure online, with total confidence.
Promise.subheading: A €150 deposit reserves your video appointment — nothing goes into production without your final validation, fabric and measurements in hand.
Promise.item1Body: Every piece is produced to your exact measurements, confirmed during the appointment. No standard sizing.
Promise.item2Body: An internal horsehair canvas, sewn rather than fused as with most online competitors. More structure, more durability over time.
Promise.item3Body: The Milanese shoulder is hand-set by our atelier: a finish usually only found on far more expensive suits.
Promise.item4Body: €645 all-inclusive: appointment, production, quality control and delivery. No hidden fees.
Promise.item5Body: Your piece is inspected before it ships. It only leaves the atelier once it meets our standard.
Promise.item6Body: Luc remains available after delivery to answer your questions and guide you if needed.

NotreHistoire.quote: The dragon does not roar in the valley. It withdraws into the mountain, and it is the mountain that becomes sacred.
NotreHistoire.paragraph1: SLY comes from 山龙隐 (Shān Lóng Yǐn): the dragon hidden in the mountain. Not absent — silent by choice, visible to those who know where to look.
NotreHistoire.paragraph2: Before cutting a single piece of fabric, Luc learned to measure himself against others for real, in competition, at the highest level. That level never lasts. It took another discipline just as demanding: ESCP, where the rigour changes ground but stays the same.
NotreHistoire.paragraph3: Then six countries. China, Italy, the United Kingdom, France, Australia, Malta — not on holiday, but to live and work there. It was in a small atelier in France, then in Shanghai at Atelier Fusari, a house established at the Ritz-Carlton for over fifteen years, that this standard finally became a craft: cutting and tailoring.
NotreHistoire.paragraph4: This craftsmanship usually stays locked inside one place. A palace, an address, an appointment book reserved for a handful of clients who can travel there.
NotreHistoire.paragraph5: SLY Atelier keeps the craft (the hand-sewn canvas, the shoulder set stitch by stitch, the meticulous measurements) and removes the address. A video call, wherever you are in the world. The same dragon, just easier to find, for those who know where to look.

ceremony.label: Ceremony
ceremony.detail: A formal, timeless look, designed to mark the big occasions.

business.label: Business
business.detail: A suit that inspires confidence and seriousness in professional daily life.

casual.label: Casual
casual.detail: A freer cut, for a less formal use without losing elegance.

daily.label: Everyday
daily.detail: A versatile, comfortable piece, built to last, day after day.

roma.label: Notch
roma.sub: Classic construction, light shoulders & notch lapel.
roma.detail: Traditional structure without excess, notch lapel. The ceremony suit par excellence.

milano.label: Milano
milano.sub: Classic construction, light shoulders & peak lapel.
milano.detail: Same traditional structure as the Notch, but with a bolder peak lapel.

dracula.label: Dracula
dracula.detail: A powerful, charismatic look. Structured shoulders and peaked lapels that elongate the torso. Ideal for prestige ceremonies and evening events.

classic.label: Classic
classic.detail: A timeless, comfortable cut that never goes out of style. Ideal for everyday wear.

slim.label: Slim
slim.detail: Closer to the body for a sleeker, more contemporary silhouette.

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.detail: More freedom of movement, a softer, more relaxed drape.

one.label: 1 Button
one.detail: Elongates the silhouette, highlights the lapel. Ideal for formal occasions or evening events.

two.label: 2 Buttons
two.detail: Versatile and modern, suited to any occasion. The most common choice in contemporary tailoring.

db4x2.label: Double-breasted
db4x2.detail: Two crossed rows of buttons. Inspires confidence and authority. A bold choice to stand out.

full.label: Full lining
full.detail: A perfect drape, effortless glide when putting it on. Premium finish. Ideal for formal suits and cold seasons.

half.label: Half lining
half.sub: Lined on the upper half only.
half.detail: More breathable than a full lining, while keeping the jacket's structure. Perfect for spring and summer.

none.label: Unlined
none.detail: Ultra-light and breathable. A relaxed, artisanal look. Recommended for summer fabrics like linen or cotton.

checks.label: Checks
checks.sub: Glen plaid, Prince of Wales, Windowpane…
checks.detail: Subtle or bold, checks give character without overdoing it.

stripes.label: Stripes
stripes.detail: Stripes elongate the silhouette. A classic of English and Italian tailoring.

exotic.label: Exotic patterns
exotic.detail: For connoisseurs who want to stand out with subtlety.

classic.label: Classic
classic.detail: A timeless pair of trousers, neither too tight nor too loose. Goes with any jacket.

slim.label: Slim
slim.detail: A modern, sleek silhouette, tapered towards the ankle. Ideal with a fitted jacket.

loose.label: Loose
loose.detail: A relaxed, contemporary cut, more freedom of movement. Perfect with a relaxed jacket.

standard.label: Standard
standard.detail: A simple, versatile setup, with belt loops, made for wearing a belt.

double.label: Side adjusters
double.detail: A military-inspired style: two adjustable buckles at the hips and a continuous front, no belt.

none.label: No pleats
none.detail: The trousers fall straight against the leg. A clean, modern, versatile look.

single.label: Single pleat
single.detail: A pleat that opens towards the side seam. More ease at the waist and comfort when sitting.

double.label: Double pleat
double.detail: Two pleats that open towards the side seam. Classic style, maximum fullness and comfort.

plain.label: Plain hem
plain.detail: The fabric is folded inside the leg for a clean finish. The most classic, versatile finish.

turnup4.label: 4cm cuff
turnup4.detail: A cuff that reveals more of the ankle, elongates the silhouette and adds weight for a better drape.

marron.label: Amber horn
marron.detail: The great classic of made-to-measure: amber reflections and warm marbling, each button slightly unique.

brun-craquele.label: Dark brown horn
brun-craquele.detail: A deep brown with a naturally crackled texture, for a finish that's both discreet and bold.

noir.label: Black horn
noir.detail: A matte, solid black, resolutely understated. Goes with any fabric colour.

marbre.label: Marbled horn
marbre.detail: Grey and white veins on a dark base, for a button with a more graphic character.

bleu.label: Blue-tinted horn
bleu.detail: A horn tinted in an intense midnight blue, for a discreet, refined touch of colour.

ivoire.label: Ivory horn
ivoire.detail: A bright, light tone with slightly smoked edges, ideal for light fabrics and summer outfits.

notch.label: Notch lapel
notch.detail: The most versatile shape, with a clean notch between the collar and lapel. Suits any occasion.

peak.label: Peak lapel
peak.detail: A lapel that points upward, more formal and bold. Traditionally paired with double-breasted jackets and formal wear.

8,5.label: 8.5 cm
8,5.sub: Slim and discreet: a low-profile lapel, very contemporary in its restraint, for a sleeker silhouette.

9,5.label: 9.5 cm
9,5.sub: Our recommendation: enough presence to give the jacket character, without ever tipping into excess.

11.label: 11 cm
11.sub: Wide and bold: the power-suit lapel, for a commanding look that immediately draws the eye.

full.label: Full lining
full.detail: Maximum comfort and a perfect glide when putting them on. Ideal for winter and structured fabrics.

half.label: Half lining
half.detail: A good compromise between comfort and breathability: limits friction without weighing the trousers down.

none.label: Unlined
none.detail: Light and breathable, for summer fabrics like linen or lightweight cotton.

inside.label: Inside jacket
inside.sub: Embroidered on the left side of the inner lining.

bleu-ciel.label: Sky blue
bleu-ciel.sub: Fresh and versatile, the most worn after white.

bleu-fonce.label: Dark blue
bleu-fonce.sub: Bolder, works as well alone as with a suit.

rose-pale.label: Pale pink
rose-pale.sub: A discreet touch of colour, very popular in business settings.

raye-bleu.label: Blue stripes
raye-bleu.sub: Fine stripes on a light ground, an English classic.

raye-fine.label: Tone-on-tone stripes
raye-fine.sub: A subtle texture, almost solid from a distance.

classic.label: Classic
classic.detail: A timeless cut with ease throughout the chest. The most versatile everyday choice.

slim.label: Fitted
slim.detail: Closer to the body at the waist and arms, for a clean look — perfect worn under a jacket.

relaxed.label: Relaxed
relaxed.detail: More freedom of movement and a softer drape — at ease outside the office.

italien.label: Italian collar
italien.detail: An open, elegant collar, with or without a tie — the most versatile today.

boutonne.label: Button-down collar
boutonne.detail: The collar points button onto the shirt — an American classic, perfect without a tie.

francais.label: French collar
francais.detail: The most formal collar, cut for a tie or bow tie.

simple.label: Button cuff
simple.detail: The everyday cuff, just as easy to wear with or without a jacket.

mousquetaire.label: French cuff
mousquetaire.detail: Fastens with cufflinks — the most formal touch, for special occasions.

cuff.label: Cuff
cuff.sub: Embroidered on the cuff, discreet and classic.

tail.label: Shirt tail
tail.sub: Embroidered at the bottom, invisible once worn.
